constraints: must sell mug for at least $10
agents.name: Alice

constraints: does not know mug's true value
agents.name: Bob

causes.hypothesis: Higher reservation price leads to higher final price
causes.name: Alice's reservation price

causes.hypothesis: Higher maximum willingness to pay leads to higher final price
causes.name: Bob's maximum willingness to pay

causes.hypothesis: Higher true value leads to higher final price
causes.name: Mug's true value

interaction.stopping_rule: agreement on price or refusal to trade

outcome.measurement_question: what was the final price agreed upon by Alice and Bob?
outcome.name: final price
outcome.operationalization: the agreed price at which the mug is sold

scenario: two people bargaining over a mug
